'If Evergreen is played from arsenal, put it on the bottom of its owner's deck when the combat chain closes.' Earth Action - Attack (BriarBlitzDeck). Identical printed text to .drafts/evergreen_blue.json, which verified this exact shape end to end; only the slug differs.

TIMING: ON_COMBAT_CLOSE is a mapped trigger (trigger_types.py:82); engine._dsl_combat_close_listener dispatches it to combat.attack_card WHILE COMBAT STILL EXISTS, and _close_step emits 'combat_chain_close' BEFORE _close_combat_chain moves the attack to the graveyard - so the ability resolves while Evergreen is still the attack card on the chain.

PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL (condition_types.py:789-809) reads card.played_from_zone, stamped by play.py at the moment of play and surviving the arsenal -> chain move (prev_zone fallback). True exactly when this copy was played from arsenal. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK matches the shipped close-step spelling on attack cards (evr/swing_big_red.json) and is true at dispatch by construction.

PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK (effect_types.py:1618-1639) moves THIS card via put_object with position None = append = bottom of the controller's deck (controller == owner here). The chain-close relocation is the documented Herald-of-Protection path: _close_combat_chain sees the card left the chain zone, drops stale membership, skips the graveyard - no duplication.

NOT OPTIONAL per official release note ('the effect is not optional'): PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK reads no optional parameter and is mandatory by default - correct as authored.
